answer: Resist sybils by binding admission to a live custody probe. The ledger sends each applicant a one-time signal that must be signed from the same key after a randomized delay, using a nonce from that account's last unsettled jobs. Peers reject any reply that is only an echo of another identity's latency, funding source, or hardware fingerprint. Eligibility requires a solo voyage of bonded, non-transferable micro-tasks at a capped rate; correlated failures slash the whole cluster. Standing up k fake names therefore costs k independent delay paths and k unshared work streams, not k cheap keys.
